queries_run: Uber robotaxi Waymo Tesla threat to Uber business 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列出自駕車業者 Alphabet(Waymo)、Amazon(Zoox)、Tesla 為正在或可能與 Uber Mobility 競爭的對手
findings.excerpt: There are also a number of companies developing and introducing autonomous vehicles and technologies 12 that either are competing with us or may compete with us in the future, including Alphabet (Waymo), Amazon (Zoox), and Tesla.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：AI 助理等新技術可能使 Uber 與消費者的關係被中介化，需求轉向競爭者
findings.excerpt: shifts in consumer behavior, including the use of new or emerging technologies, such as AI-enabled platforms and digital assistants, may disintermediate our relationship with consumers by controlling how our products are accessed, presented or selected, which could redirect demand to competitors and adversely affect our demand and growth.

findings.claim: 10-K：大眾運輸與私家車為 Mobility 替代品，私家車占多數乘客里程
findings.excerpt: Our Mobility offering competes with personal vehicle ownership and usage, which accounts for the majority of passenger miles in the markets that we serve

substitute_technology.note: 搜尋結果僅有聚合摘要，未取得可逐字引用的第三方原文；Waymo 自有 app、Tesla 低價等僅為二手說法，未列入。
